articleTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy
imageHeadline: Bleeding on birth control doesn't mean you're pregnant
imageSubtext: What breakthrough bleeding actually means and when to follow up
pinTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy | Breakthrough Bleeding Guide
pinDescription: Breakthrough bleeding is one of the most common side effects of hormonal birth control, but it can trigger anxiety about pregnancy. Learn what negative pregnancy tests actually mean, why bleeding happens months into using birth control, and when irregular bleeding needs medical follow-up.

items.label: Negative test + dual methods = pregnancy very unlikely
